summary.text: Chea Evans, listed by Ballotpedia as Chea Waters Evans, is a Democratic state representative from Chittenden-5 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a journalist, editor and publisher by background.

paragraphs.text: Chea Evans graduated from Champlain Valley Union High School, earned a B.A. in fiction writing with an education minor from St. Lawrence University in 1996, and received an M.A. in creative writing from City College of New York.
Her career experience includes working as a journalist, editor and publisher, at The Citizen, the Shelburne News and the Charlotte News before founding her own online paper, The Charlotte Bridge.
She has volunteered with the Pancreatic Cancer Action Network, the Hope Lodge and Meals on Wheels.
Evans assumed office on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate in the Chittenden-5 general election.
